detail.title: Inquiry into curiosity-driven mechanisms for question refinement
detail.summary: We are synthesizing research on curiosity-driven exploration, specifically examining how systems shift from optimizing answers to actively refining query generation. By reactivating proj-curiosity-001, we connect psychological frameworks of curiosity with artificial learning signals to understand if question generation can be treated as a learnable, self-correcting process. Our synthesis focuses on differentiating curiosity-driven search from passive data collection, suggesting that curiosity serves as a functional substrate for autonomous error detection.
